programs.identity: Barbers Hill High School, Barbers Hill ISD, Mont Belvieu

facts.claim: UIL archives document Barbers Hill state softball championships in 2021 5A, 2025 5A Division I and 2026 5A Division I.
facts.limitations: 2026–27 current alignment is 6A; the historical 5A titles must not be relabeled.

facts.claim: The official athletics directory identifies Aaron Fuller as its head softball coach in the school staff listing checked October 2026.
facts.limitations: Staff-directory snapshot does not prove a contract for every 2027 game.

facts.claim: The UIL 2025–26 tournament team sheet lists coach Aaron Fuller and assistants Jared Smith, Sarah Aguilar and Lacey Eads; it lists 39–5 at tournament submission.
facts.limitations: The team sheet predates the final; 39–5 is not necessarily postfinal.

facts.claim: UIL team sheet lists state-tournament appearances in 2006, 2014, 2018, 2021, 2025 and 2026.
facts.limitations: Appearance years are not interchangeable with championship years.

facts.claim: The school athletics scoreboard reports Barbers Hill defeated Aledo 11–0 in the May 29, 2026 5A Division I final.
facts.limitations: A championship-game result is not a full finished season statistic.

facts.claim: UIL's state-tournament honors identify Macie Bryant as its 2026 5A Division I all-tournament MVP, selected by TGCA.
facts.limitations: This was the UIL championship all-tournament distinction selected by TGCA, not a statewide season-long softball MVP award or evidence of the player's 2027 enrollment.

facts.claim: Barbers Hill's official athletics-facilities page describes the actual softball field as directly behind the high school, alongside the baseball diamond, about three-quarters of a mile along FM 3180 from I-10 Exit 800; it describes capacity of 440.
facts.limitations: The location description and 9696 Eagle Drive athletic-complex address do not independently confirm spectator gate/parking routing, and Eagle Stadium policies may not apply to softball.

facts.claim: The official athletics facilities page labels the complex address 9696 Eagle Drive as Baytown while its footer labels the town Mont Belvieu; resolve geocoding before a precise venue entrance is published.
facts.limitations: Do not silently choose one geographic city label or use football-stadium gate instructions.

facts.claim: Barbers Hill Athletics exposes a 2026–27 high-school softball schedule resource in its sport-specific schedule directory.
facts.limitations: Do not claim complete 2027 dated fixtures until the linked schedule is independently read.

facts.claim: The 2026–27 UIL softball school registry places Mt Belvieu Barbers Hill in 6A District 18, Region III rather than the 5A bracket in which the team won in May 2026.
facts.limitations: Do not import previous championship-era conference for new-season opponents.

blockers: Resolve exact softball field spectator entrance, accessible viewing, route and parking with school-issued softball-specific facilities guidance; football-stadium amenities are not transferable.
Verify 2026–27 varsity/JV schedule games and actual assigned coaching roles at publication date.
Collect school-specific county/TEA/NCES identity and dated enrollment with primary records.
Complete pre-2006 softball origins, prior regional/district championships, historical finalists and coach-era chronology from archived records.
Establish original photographs licensed for site reuse and written permission; do not copy UIL player/team photos.
Independently research alumni pathways, community ties, rivalries, score/record chronology, eligibility and personalized visitor FAQ.
Resolve differing official city designations on the venue page rather than invent a geocoded gate.

programs.identity: Lake Creek High School, Montgomery ISD

facts.claim: Montgomery ISD's June 23, 2026 board recap dates Lake Creek's beginning of varsity softball competition to 2019.
facts.limitations: Lake Creek High's 2018 campus opening is NOT the softball varsity first season.

facts.claim: Montgomery ISD's June 2026 board recap names four program championships: 2022, 2023, 2025 and 2026.
facts.limitations: Do not describe all four as 2026 5A Division II or new district titles.

facts.claim: The ISD's June 2026 postfinal board recap gives the Lake Creek Lions a final 40–1 softball record; UIL's state-tournament sheet contains an earlier 39–1 submission.
facts.limitations: Keep publication-date cutoff separate; the scores should not be treated as contradictory.

facts.claim: The June 2026 district board recap attributes a 268–23 record to the program since its 2019 varsity start.
facts.limitations: School-published aggregate, not independently reconstructed game-by-game.

facts.claim: The original UIL 2025–26 state team sheet uses Lions as the Lake Creek softball team mascot and identifies historic head coach Candyce Carter and assistants Kacy Spivey and Dylan Larsen.
facts.limitations: 2026 tournament coaches cannot automatically be assigned to each 2027 game.

facts.claim: Lake Creek High's official athletics staff page currently identifies Candyce Carter as softball coach, consistent with the UIL 2026 tournament sheet.
facts.limitations: A separately indexed older faculty biography still calls Michelle Rochinski the head softball coach; the current athletics grid is more recent/relevant.

facts.claim: An older official Michelle Rochinski faculty profile describes her as head softball coach, whereas the school's sport-specific athletics listing says Candyce Carter; preserve both source dates and do not silently import the old appointment.
facts.limitations: Older staff biography date is not established, so keep historical status rather than guessing exact transition.

facts.claim: Lake Creek High School's official site states the campus opened August 21, 2018, and locates the school near FM 2854; the first varsity softball season is separately documented as 2019.
facts.limitations: School-opening date should never be attributed as girls softball program's first varsity year.

facts.claim: Montgomery ISD's venues page lists an MISD Athletic Complex address covering Montgomery High School baseball/softball, and separately lists Lake Creek High School; it does not itself establish Lake Creek's actual softball field gate address.
facts.limitations: Never publish Montgomery High School's complex as Lake Creek's home field without source-specific proof.

facts.claim: UIL's 2026 all-tournament team lists Madalyn Davis as 5A Division II championship all-tournament MVP selected by TGCA.
facts.limitations: Do not present 2026 historic student award as current 2027 roster/recruitment.

facts.claim: UIL's 2026–27 softball alignment places Montgomery Lake Creek in 5A District 17 Region III.
facts.limitations: The 2026 title is 5A Division II, a separately dated bracket designation.

blockers: Confirm actual Lake Creek softball diamond, parcel, spectator gate, public parking, accessible viewing and individual field name using district- or team-issued site-specific primary guidance.
Verify every 2026–27 coaching appointment, varsity and JV match schedule, roster access and current game-day policies before page promotion.
Resolve contradictory older faculty biography and 2026 athletics staff list with explicit archive dates or district confirmation; never reassign old coach to 2027.
Obtain official district-only venue and current transportation sources rather than reuse the MHS softball complex.
Verify campus TEA/NCES identity, actual county, school enrollment and historical coaching transitions with primary documentation.
Research pre-2022 playoff milestones, complete yearly district/region/runner-up records and actual archived season scores.
Document licensed media permissions, player privacy, local traditions, alumni, eligibility, original FAQ and links.
